## Method overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | Dynamic pool models → Equilibrium per-recruit |
| **Method name** | YPR / SPR / Thompson & Bell |
| **Short description** | Equilibrium yield- and spawning-biomass-per-recruit analysis from growth, natural mortality, maturity and selectivity, giving F-based reference points. |
| **Main outputs** | YPR, SPR, proxy reference points |
| **Typical use case** | Age-based |

::: {.callout-tip}
